limits: 12 newly authored synthetic tasks, 3 per category; screening only, not general accuracy proof.
Code cases test comprehension, not code generation. Tool cases test JSON arguments, not actual API calls.
All tasks require strict JSON; this screen combines answer correctness and format adherence.
1024-token input with inert padding, greedy generation capped at 128 tokens, thinking off.
Stop after a paired control-correct/candidate-wrong result; no offset by gains elsewhere.
No runtime adoption based on this screen, even with zero regressions.

cases.prompt: For Python 3, let f(xs) return list(dict.fromkeys(x % 3 for x in xs if x >= 0)). Return {"outputs": [f([4,1,-1,2,5,6]), f([]), f([0,3,2,2])]}.
A tank starts with 180 litres. Remove one third of its water, then add 25 litres, then remove 20% of the current water. Return {"litres": integer_remaining}.
依據本文回答，不補充外部資訊：甲倉週一收到30箱，其中8箱送往乙倉；週二乙倉退回其中3箱。甲倉原先沒有貨。回傳 {"甲倉箱數":整數,"乙倉保留箱數":整數}。

Allowed tool: set_alarm, arguments hour (integer 0..23), minute (integer 0..59), enabled (boolean). User asks: Set an enabled alarm for 7:05 in the evening. Return exactly {"name": tool_name, "arguments": arguments_object}.
Find the smallest positive integer n such that n leaves remainder 2 when divided by 5 and remainder 3 when divided by 7. Return {"n": integer}.
公告：一般訂單在週二、週四出貨。冷藏訂單只在週四出貨。今天是週二，沒有假日或例外。甲是一般訂單，乙是冷藏訂單，兩筆均已付款並可出貨。回傳 {"今天可出貨":[訂單名稱],"今天不可出貨":[訂單名稱]}。

Allowed tool: search_files, arguments query (string), limit (integer), include_archived (boolean). User asks: Find files containing the literal text error: timeout, return at most 3, exclude archived files. Return exactly {"name": tool_name, "arguments": arguments_object}.

A bag contains 4 red and 6 blue balls. Draw two balls uniformly without replacement. What is the probability of two red balls? Return the reduced fraction as {"numerator":integer,"denominator":integer}.
只按這份紀錄推論：小林比小陳早到；小黃比小林晚到，但比小陳早到；小周最後到。四人抵達時間不同。回傳 {"由早到晚":[姓名依序]}。

Allowed tool: convert_temperature, arguments value (number), from_unit ("C" or "F"), to_unit ("C" or "F"). User asks: Convert minus forty degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit. Return the tool call, not the converted answer, exactly {"name": tool_name, "arguments": arguments_object}; use an integer for value.
